questions.question: Which attribute on the <a> element defines the link destination URL?
questions.explanation: The href (Hypertext Reference) attribute specifies the target URL destination for the link.

questions.question: When using target="_blank" to open a new tab, which attribute is essential for cybersecurity?
questions.hint: It prevents the target page from hijacking the opening tab.
questions.explanation: rel="noopener noreferrer" prevents reverse tabnabbing attacks by severing the window.opener reference.

questions.question: What is the correct protocol scheme to launch an email client from a link?
questions.explanation: The mailto: URL scheme initiates an email draft in the user's default email client.

questions.question: How do you navigate up one directory level in a relative file path?
questions.hint: Double dots denote the parent directory.
questions.explanation: ../ moves one level up in the file hierarchy relative to the current file.

questions.question: Which link text is best for web accessibility and screen readers?
questions.hint: Descriptive labels explain where the link leads out of context.
questions.explanation: Descriptive link text clearly informs all users and screen readers of the destination without requiring surrounding context.
